evidence: src/domain/order.ts: advanceTo calls nextState(this.currentState) and cancel calls isCancellable(this.currentState), both from src/domain/order-state.ts, so the transition rules aren't repeated.
src/domain/order-state.ts: FULFILMENT_FLOW, CANCELLABLE, nextState, isCancellable, isOrderState and assertOrderState all live in one file.
src/domain/order-line.ts: the OrderLine constructor is the only place that enforces 'Quantity must be a positive integer'.
src/domain/product.ts: canReserve(quantity) holds the availability rule, and reserve/release are the only methods that change `reserved`.
src/domain/stock-reservation.ts: reserveStock calls product.canReserve and productFor(...).reserve, and releaseStock calls product.release, so the Product methods are used rather than bypassed.
src/domain/stock-reservation.ts: the insufficient_stock error message in reserveStock repeats the one in Product.reserve, but the availability check itself still comes from canReserve (minor).
src/domain/order-repository.ts and src/domain/product-repository.ts: both are interfaces over the module's own Order, OrderState and Product types.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module covers one domain: orders, order lines, order state, products and stock reservation, plus the repository interfaces and a shared error type. Each invariant has one home. The order-state rules are in order-state.ts (FULFILMENT_FLOW, nextState, isCancellable), and Order.advanceTo and Order.cancel call those functions. The positive-quantity rule is only in the OrderLine constructor. The stock-availability rule is only in Product.canReserve. stock-reservation.ts goes through Product's own methods (canReserve, reserve, release) rather than changing stock directly. Every file uses the single DomainError/DomainErrorCode type. Minor concern: reserveStock throws its own insufficient_stock DomainError with the same message as Product.reserve. The check itself comes from canReserve, and the up-front pass is needed so either every line is reserved or none is. Only the error message is repeated, not the rule, so this isn't a violation.
